query_order: For each Q01–Q24, run that query, retain its results, then inspect/acquire at most the first three distinct official-publisher PDF candidates before advancing. Candidate set per query is fixed from that query response; no follow-on discovery expansion.

stop_policy.success: Stop immediately once eight eligible complete notices are retained, including six general proposed-comment notices, two conditional/negative controls, and notices from at least six states.
stop_policy.hard_cap: If success is not achieved earlier, stop after resolving the bounded first-three-candidate set for Q24. No search or queued candidate processing after Q24. Log shortfall.

official_source_rule: Official publisher or official rulemaking register only. Third-party results are leads; no search snippets as source evidence.
result_retention: Persist query and timestamp/timezone, result rank, title and URL for all query returns; log query order including empty results.
